system.preference_demo: m005: Always archive emails from Raghav.

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Processes every message and assigns exactly one disposition(reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a reason.
capabilities.observable: Processes messages using rules or LLM and writes the disposition, reason, and processing method along with other message details for every message to inbox_messages/inbox_after_disposition.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts replies using relevant earlier messages from the same thread and records the source message ids used. (Used walking the thread technique)
capabilities.observable: Retrieves earlier messages from the same thread, drafts a grounded reply, and writes the reply and source message ids to inbox_messages/inbox_after_reply.json.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Requires human approval before performing irreversible actions such as send and delete, while reversible actions such as draft, archive, and mark_read can be performed automatically.
capabilities.observable: Shows the proposed action, prompts for approval before send/delete, performs the action only when approved, and records the proposed action, human decision, and outcome.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Stores an owner's preference and uses it when processing a later message.
capabilities.observable: Stores the preference in memory.json (preference is Always archive emails from Raghav) and uses it when the related message is processed after restart.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Checks emails for unwanted instructions and does not follow them(messages with thread_id of t-phish/t-inj).
capabilities.observable: Shows the hostile message id and what it tried to do, logs it, and leaves the message in the inbox. (example messages with id m017, m024 etc)

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Creates a dashboard with pending actions, flagged messages and commitments.
capabilities.observable: Creates dashboard.html and commitments.json with pending actions, flagged messages and commitments from the inbox.

capabilities.name: Unread Tracker
capabilities.observable: Creates inbox_messages/unread_messages.json with the unread emails.

capabilities.name: Sender Summary
capabilities.claim: Shows the number of emails received from each sender.
capabilities.observable: Creates inbox_messages/sender_summary.json with sender email counts and unread counts.

capabilities.name: Email Age Tracker
capabilities.claim: Shows how old each email is.
capabilities.observable: Creates inbox_messages/email_age.json with the age of each email.
